title: [Graal master] opentelemetry native integration test fails with MissingReflectionRegistrationError
body:

### Expected behavior

Native integration test passes

### Actual behavior

Native integration test fails

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer:

1. Grab a GraalVM master build. E.g. from our [CI here](https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/19913643705/artifacts/4758518961)
2. Build quarkus
3. Run `opentelemetry` native integration test

### Mandrel or GraalVM version (if different from Java)

Graal master build (GraalVM CE build), revision: 5d4eee5bd6857e3a858d0bc144e11c61eb4383ff

### Quarkus version or git rev

main branch

### Additional information

See the CI failure here:
